Aberdeen is a thriving area with strong demand for reliable boiler repair and servicing services. Local properties range from period Victorian and Edwardian homes through to modern new-build developments, each presenting different plumbing requirements and challenges.

Our Gas Safe registered engineers serve all areas of Aberdeen and the surrounding Aberdeen City region. Whether you're in the town centre or the surrounding residential areas, we provide prompt, professional boiler repair services with transparent pricing and no hidden call-out charges.

With years of experience working across Aberdeen City, our engineers understand the specific plumbing challenges faced by local homeowners. From the older pipe infrastructure common in period properties to the modern systems found in newer developments, our team has the expertise to handle any boiler repair and servicing requirement.

We cover all postcodes across Aberdeen with same-day availability for urgent work. All our engineers are fully qualified, insured, and committed to leaving your property clean and tidy after every job.

faqs.q: Why does my boiler keep losing pressure?
faqs.a: Pressure loss is usually caused by a small leak in the system, a faulty pressure relief valve, or a failing expansion vessel. A Gas Safe engineer can diagnose and fix the root cause — simply topping up the pressure is a temporary fix.

faqs.q: My boiler is making a banging noise — what does it mean?
faqs.a: Banging, kettling, or clunking sounds usually indicate limescale buildup on the heat exchanger, a failing pump, or trapped air in the system. All are repairable by a qualified engineer.

faqs.q: How long does a boiler repair take?
faqs.a: Most boiler repairs take 1-3 hours. If specialist parts need ordering, the initial visit diagnoses the fault and the repair is completed on a second visit typically within 24-48 hours.

faqs.q: Can I use my boiler while it is making an error code?
faqs.a: Depends on the code. Some error codes allow limited operation; others indicate a dangerous fault that requires immediate shutdown. Never ignore a gas smell — turn off at the gas meter and call the National Gas Emergency line on 0800 111 999.

localParagraph: Aberdeen's mixed housing stock — from the city's iconic granite-built Victorian and Edwardian terraces in areas like Ferryhill and Rosemount to post-war semis and modern developments in Cults and Bridge of Don — means boiler repair engineers here need a broad working knowledge of heating systems spanning several decades. Scotland's colder climate places greater seasonal demand on boilers, and with Aberdeen experiencing mixed water hardness, some properties see moderate limescale accumulation over time, which can quietly reduce boiler efficiency or contribute to pressure issues if left unaddressed. Whether you're in a traditional tenement flat near the city centre or a newer build on the outskirts, a qualified Gas Safe registered engineer will diagnose faults accurately, from faulty diverter valves and failed thermocouples to pump failures and PCB issues. Catching problems early — particularly before the winter months — is especially worthwhile in Aberdeen, where reliable central heating is not a luxury but a practical necessity for comfortable, safe living throughout the year.
whatItInvolves: Boiler repair covers fault diagnosis and component replacement to restore a failing or broken boiler to full working order. Common faults include pressure loss, ignition failure, pump failure, heat exchanger leaks, PCB failure, and faulty diverter valves. A qualified Gas Safe engineer will identify the root cause — not just reset the fault code.
process: The engineer connects a diagnostic reader to your boiler's PCB to extract fault codes, then conducts a systematic inspection of the key components: heat exchanger, pump, igniter, gas valve, pressure relief valve, and expansion vessel. Once the fault is identified you'll receive a fixed repair quote. Parts are ordered and fitted on the same visit where possible, or next-day for specialist components.
whatToExpect: Most boiler repairs are completed in 1-3 hours. Always ask for a written report of the fault and the work carried out — you'll need this if the boiler fails again under guarantee. If the repair cost exceeds 50% of a new boiler's value, a replacement is usually better value long-term.
